from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyStatistic(BaseModel):
    """A single month's housing construction statistics as reported in a document."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month in YYYY-MM format")
    housing_starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Housing Starts")
    housing_starts_mom_change: float | None = Field(description="Month-over-Month percentage change in Housing Starts")
    building_permits_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Building Permits")
    building_permits_mom_change: float | None = Field(description="Month-over-Month percentage change in Building Permits")
    source_document_id: str | None = Field(description="Identifier of the source document (e.g., 'Document 1')")
    is_revised: bool | None = Field(description="True if the data is a revised value (marked 'r' in source)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_statistics: list[MonthlyStatistic]
